title: Abort on resize with airline.

labels.name: bug-crash
labels.description: issue reporting a crash or segfault

body:
To reproduce,
1. Install airline.
2. Enable airline's tabline (`let g:airline#extensions#tabline#enabled = 1`)
3. Open vim with two tabs `vim -p a b`.
4. Shrink the window such that the two tabs no longer fit.
